title: The paced Add site run tests settle on a slow disk instead of failing after about 100 ms of loop turns
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test: node --import tsx --test --test-reporter=tap scripts/test/host-run.test.ts
S2: Read the lines for the tests 'a paced run still settles when the disk answers late' and 'a run id on the real clock is one the fleet handover accepts'.
expect: Both tests report ok. The first keeps every libuv thread busy for about one second while a paced run goes through (pre-fix: 'run did not settle' after 20000 loop turns). The second shows a real-clock run id passes the fleet handover's safe-id check.
evidence: CI run 40675889623 (build check, tests 2/2), 28/10/2026: attempt 1 failed 'run did not settle' and 'both parts must run' in scripts/test/host-run.test.ts, attempt 2 passed on the same commit.
fence: scripts/test/host-run.test.ts pacedSettled: a wall-clock deadline (performance.now) instead of a count of setImmediate turns.

tests: a paced run still settles when the disk answers late
a run id on the real clock is one the fleet handover accepts
